      N        S ms softmax ms       O ms   total ms   softmax     softmax       S and P

   4096      60.927      3.417     54.451    118.796      2.9%       235.7    1073741824

Each stage runs once per head (8 launches; every head has its own buffers). Each time is per call
of the stage: the best of 5 timed runs, each repeating the stage until it lasts at least 2 ms.
Softmax GB/s counts its minimum traffic: the visible half of S read once and all of P written once.
Your kernel reads the visible half three times, so it moves more than it is credited with.
"S and P bytes" is what the unfused path keeps in device memory for the scores of all heads.
Every stage's output was spot-checked (6 rows of every head) before its time was reported.

results.bench_text:
causal attention forward, batch 1, 8 heads, d = 128, scale 1/sqrt(d); flash with B_c = 16; best of 5 timed runs
      n    flash ms unfused ms     flash /       flash    unfused  unfused S and P
                                   unfused     GFLOP/s    GFLOP/s           bytes
    512       1.958      1.326        1.48       274.3      404.9        16777216
   1024       6.352      4.930        1.29       338.1      435.6        67108864
   2048      23.606     16.997        1.39       363.9      505.4       268435456
   4096     109.237     75.132        1.45       314.5      457.3      1073741824

GFLOP/s counts causal attention's useful work, 2 n^2 d per head: half of the 4 n^2 d of the two
full products, since half of S is masked. The unfused path computes all of S and all of P V anyway.
"flash / unfused" below 1 means flash attention is faster. The unfused path is lab 20.1's pipeline:
M3 for S, lab 20.1's reference softmax, M2 for O, every head in buffers of its own; "S and P bytes"
is the device memory those two take, which flash attention never allocates.
Each time is the best of 5 timed runs of one call, each run repeating the call until it lasts at
least 2 ms; both outputs were spot-checked (6 rows of every head) before their times were reported.
These are measurements of this machine, at these sizes.
